name: Accessible Palette Generator
summary: Generate WCAG-aware color palettes from a brand color — semantic tokens, contrast pairs, CSS variables.
description: Enter a primary/brand color and get a semantic palette for light or dark UI themes. Each token is tuned for readable text and UI contrast at WCAG AA or AAA. Review contrast pairs with pass/fail badges, preview swatches, and export CSS custom properties or JSON design tokens.

faqs.question: What tokens are generated?
faqs.answer: Background, foreground, primary, primary-foreground, secondary, muted, muted-foreground, accent, and border — similar to common design-system naming.

faqs.question: How is contrast calculated?
faqs.answer: WCAG 2 relative luminance. AA targets 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text/UI; AAA targets 7:1 and 4.5:1 respectively.

faqs.question: Can I use this for dark mode?
faqs.answer: Yes. Switch Theme to Dark to generate a dark canvas with adjusted foreground and surface colors.

faqs.question: Is my color sent to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Palette generation runs entirely in your browser.
